Selection rationale 
Article: “only available paper.” Model: the user chose 2013 because it is newer; 1985 
is also good for comparison. Recency does not demonstrate numerical superiority or 
whole-LME suitability. Recorded rationale 
Model extraction 
All 240 final Table 1 source cells match accepted 2013 values. One Table 2 diet 
matrix is captioned both years despite year-specific sardine/anchovy prose. Nine 
nonunit diet columns, accepted normalization, GS 0.2, solved accumulation, 
missing/default catch/migration and single-detritus routing remain documented. 
Supplementary depth-bin areas total 1,223 km² versus main 2,230 km²; no scientific 
repair, rescaling or new normalization. Source review | Source cells

Geographic fit 
Approximate A: 0.15–0.23% of the target region. B: 95–100% of the study area inside 
the target. Indicative ranges; graphical trace differs from the reported area. 
Temporal fit 
Static 2013 coefficients and source catch/biomass splits are transferred across 1950–
2019. The model postdates the 1980s regime shift; fixed Kyoto guild composition 
does not describe observed whole-LME change across years, fleets or catch bases. 
Other 
Historical GE, TE and With Egestion diagnoses remain WARN; strict balance passes. 
Tongue sole (30) EE is 0. Every source-recipient entry is finite and nonnegative. Exact 
old/current loader parity supports reuse; no fresh solve was performed. Production 
eligibility remains false. Full matrices | Loader parity

Overall confidence is the weaker membership/allocation component. Complete 2013 S4 detailed fleet catches 
supply Medium split proxies; incomplete catch sets use complete final Table 1 biomass with common 
catchability assumed. Missing source rows and loaded zeros are distinct. Both proxy types transfer local 
historical composition across regional years, fleets and bases; taxon-specific observed shares were unavailable. 
Allocation evidence 
No unresolved labels remain. Very low: 143 labels, 52.9828% of landings and 61.2201% of classic PPR. Absent 
northern/deep fish, salmon, sharks, broad residuals and jellyfish retain explicit analogue limits. This cohort 
contributes 66.52% of GE, 76.86% of TE and 64.39% of With Egestion PPR under the same controls; assignment 
completeness does not establish scientific suitability. Method-specific contributions

R is the Sea Around Us Sea of Japan / East Sea LME target. S follows the dashed model boundary in source

reported 2,230 km². The dashed border is the model area; white circles are sampling stations. Figure 
reproduced without geographic alteration; article CC BY 4.0.  Original figure | Methods | CC BY 4.0

Approximate trace S is 1,681 km² and intersection 1,654 km²: central graphical A≈0.17%, B≈98%. The trace is 
24.62% below the reported 2,230 km², an unresolved discrepancy larger than graphical sensitivity. Indicative 
Low ranges A≈0.15–0.23%, B≈95–100% retain both uncertainties; they are not statistical intervals.
